_readme: Copy this file to accounts.json (gitignored — never commit it).
TWO AUTH WORKFLOWS — use whichever fits your situation:
WORKFLOW A — Company SSO (direct profile per account):
Set 'profile' to your AWS CLI SSO profile for that account.
Run: aws sso login --profile <name>  before auditing.
WORKFLOW B — Cross-account role assumption (client deployments):
Set 'role_arn' to an existing read-only role in that account.
Set 'external_id' only if the role's trust policy has an ExternalId condition.
Omit external_id entirely if the role has no ExternalId condition.
You can mix both workflows in one file.
default_region:  fallback region for accounts without their own 'region'
default_profile: fallback AWS CLI profile (overridden per-account by 'profile')
external_id:     global ExternalId fallback for all role-assumption accounts
